library: Gumball production scene templates — complete animated scenes

tag_vocabulary.angle-variant-puppet: A puppet drawn/built for one specific camera angle (top shot, extreme close-up) instead of transforming the stock puppet.
tag_vocabulary.beat-layer: The scene or a puppet carries a layer named for the beat/music grid; animation is timed against it.
tag_vocabulary.costume-variant-puppet: A puppet variant built for a costume/state (pyjamas, hurt, sporty) rather than redressing the stock puppet.
tag_vocabulary.cycle-multi-scale: The same library cycle is placed at two or more very different scales in one scene.
tag_vocabulary.dialogue-two-shot: Two characters staged in one shot for dialogue, typically one scene layer per character over a shared background.
tag_vocabulary.dissection-gag: A character is staged as separately placed puppet parts (limbs/head/torso as independent scene elements).
tag_vocabulary.face-comp-driven: Face-comp keyframes outnumber body-puppet keyframes — the face system carries the performance.
tag_vocabulary.forced-perspective: The same item is placed at scale ratios >= 2.5x inside one scene to fake depth.
tag_vocabulary.head-comp-swap: An episode-specific head/face comp is swapped onto the stock puppet for one story beat.
tag_vocabulary.layout-mov-reference: The scene file embeds a layout/reference video layer (a guide, not scene content).
tag_vocabulary.mask-layer: The scene solves occlusion with a mask layer.
tag_vocabulary.multi-character-staging: Three or more characters staged and choreographed in one shot.
tag_vocabulary.nested-master-symbol: The whole scene performance is nested inside one master symbol placed over background layers.
tag_vocabulary.overlay-hands: A dedicated overlay layer puts hands on top of an occluding element (covers, props).
tag_vocabulary.per-character-mask: Two or more mask layers, one per character, solve shared-occlusion staging.
tag_vocabulary.photo-plate: The background is a photographic plate composited under the vector puppets.
tag_vocabulary.punch-zoom: An in-scene camera punch: puppet scale jump + background swap inside one scene file, no cut.
tag_vocabulary.rough-layer-shipped: Animator rough layers ship inside the clean production file.
tag_vocabulary.run-cycle-library: Locomotion is a reusable library cycle symbol, not scene-specific drawings.
tag_vocabulary.solo-close-up: A single character fills the shot; performance is carried by face comps and scale.
tag_vocabulary.speed-smear: Background or limbs are reduced to speed smears/lines at full motion.
tag_vocabulary.transformation-gag: A transformation is staged by placement/scale/part swaps — no morph drawings.
